Container.Name: Chirp-Headscale
Container.Overview: Optional companion to Chirp: a self-hosted Headscale (Tailscale control server) so Chirp stations outside your home network can reach your Chirp server privately. Creates its own reusable key on first start and hands it to the Chirp container.
Container.Description: Install only if you have stations away from home. Before the first start, copy config.yaml from github.com/joshsalvi/chirp (chirp-server-instances/headscale/config.yaml) to the Config path below and set server_url to the public HTTPS address that reaches this container (see Chirp-Caddy). Map the same Shared folder into the Chirp container at /shared.

Config.Name: Config file
Config.Description: Headscale config; set server_url before first start.

Config.Name: State
Config.Description: Keys and the node database. Keep on the cache or appdata share.

Config.Name: Socket
Config.Description: Unix socket. Must be on a share the Unraid mover never touches (appdata on cache, set to Prefer/Only).

Config.Name: Shared
Config.Description: Where the auth key is written for Chirp.
